delta.comment: PLAN HARDENING COMPLETE (P-006): Hardened the plan around four failure boundaries: (1) contract-version metadata must be additive/backward-compatible and must not redefine older manifest meaning; (2) detection must use explicit per-shell markers and classify unknown/ambiguous files without auto-apply; (3) backup must happen before any accepted refresh and manifest checksum/contract updates must occur only after the write; (4) custom-section extraction/reattachment must be deterministic, with unsafe preservation falling back to operator review. Scope is limited to target-workspace Tune/verifier support and related tests; current startup templates, repository-root scripts, and Plan 3 remain excluded. Hardening verdict: READY FOR PLAN REVIEW.

PLAN REVIEW PASS: Reviewed against the stash scope, Plan 1 exclusion, Stage 2-hour width-isolation rule, P-006 hardening result, and non-destructive Tune policy. No blocking findings. Required task split: (1) startup contract/version metadata and deterministic classification across verifier/manifest support; (2) Tune proposal/apply migration with backup and supported custom-section preservation; (3) focused regression tests plus skill/install cross-reference and verification updates only where evidence requires them. Acceptance criteria explicitly cover unchanged-manifest legacy files, missing/current/ambiguous/customized scripts, idempotency, and no overwrite on unsafe content. Verdict: PASS; ready for harvest.

HARVEST/SHIPMENT HANDOFF: Plan 017-DL from stash 015B2914 was harvested into 125-F with tasks 125.001-T, 125.002-T, and 125.003-T. Shipment 134-S is queued and manifest-verified. Dependency order is 125.002-T -> 125.001-T -> 125.003-T. Stash entry is consumed by this feature.
